message.content:
A vertical rectangular magazine cover features a black background. At the top left is a solid red rectangle. Large white capital letters spell "TEMPO" across the upper center. Above this, white text reads "Sengkarut Pengusutan Kematian Vina H.68" and "Pemecatan Massal Karyawan Tokopedia H.80". 

Centrally, a large red stylized fingerprint forms a human face with short hair and glasses. The red lines of the fingerprint create facial features against the black negative space. 

At the bottom right, white and grey text reads "SETERU PARA PETUGAS PARTAI" above a paragraph starting with "Komisi Pemberantasan Korupsi mengusut kembali keterlibatan Sekretaris Jenderal PDI Perjuangan Hasto Kristiyanto dalam korupsi dan perburuan Harun Masiku." The text ends with "H.30".

The bottom left contains white text: "24-30 JUNI 2024", "RP 50.000", "MAJALAH.TEMPO.CO", "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN", and "ISSN: 0126 - 4273". A white barcode and a QR code are also present. Small, partially obscured white text is visible underneath the "TEMPO" logo.
